scripts.dist: pnpm build && pnpm build:runner && pnpm build:web && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64
scripts.build:runner: esbuild ../runner/src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/runner.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __beamRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __beamRequire(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @beam/web build && rm -rf dist/web && cp -R ../web/dist dist/web
